about.title: About Host Pilot
about.subtitle: Our mission is to provide safe, clean, and academically conducive residential accommodation for students.
about.vision_desc: Host Pilot aims to eliminate seat allocation ambiguity, complex billing, and mismanagement through modern digital technology and administrative transparency.
about.team_desc: Dedicated wardens and staff working round the clock to ensure student security and hostel welfare.
about.rule_1: Gate Closing Time: Main hostel gate closes strictly at 9:30 PM every night.
about.rule_2: Study Hours: Quiet study environment must be maintained from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
about.rule_3: Visitor Policy: Guests and guardians may meet residents only in designated visitor rooms during scheduled hours.
about.rule_4: Cleanliness: Personal rooms and common areas must be kept clean and tidy at all times.
